description_en: As of October 2024, only the south-facing wing and a part of the east wing remain. The historic courtyard features aśivaliṅgain its center which is surrounded by numerous shrines and statues.  The courtyard is enclosed by a fence of corrugated metal sheets and is covered by a temporary metal roof. According to a member of the priest family, the building is earmarked for restoration.
